title: Box · Straight push
description: The object is lowered into the settled bed, then dragged 0.9 m along +x over 2 s by a PD-controlled force and torque on its centre of mass. The sand's reaction acts back on the body.

title: Box · Circular push
description: The object is lowered onto a circle of radius 0.30 m and driven around it at about 0.94 m/s for 2.4 s (1.2 laps) by the same PD controller.

title: Box · Stamping (up and down)
description: The object is driven vertically at 2 Hz with a 12 cm stroke at a fixed position, to mimic a legged robot stamping. The lowest object-centre height is -0.03 m (-0.01 m for the sphere).

title: Box · Free drop and throw
description: The object hovers 0.40 m above the settled bed for 3 s, then is released with an impulse of about 1 m/s along +x. After release no controller acts: free body dynamics under gravity and sand contact for 3 s.

title: Cube of sand · Drop
description: A 0.40 m cube of particles, released 0.20 m above open flat ground, 6 s. Dropped (no initial velocity). Both simulators start from the same particle state; the NeRD rollout is given the true initial velocity in its position history.

title: Cube of sand · Throw
description: A 0.40 m cube of particles, released 0.20 m above open flat ground, 6 s. Tossed (1.0 m/s along +x, 0.25 m/s up). Both simulators start from the same particle state; the NeRD rollout is given the true initial velocity in its position history.
